title: How Jailbreak Defenses Work and Ensemble? A Mechanistic Investigation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mechanistic investigation of jailbreak defense strategies in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Although it utilizes safety benchmarks (MM-SafetyBench, MOSSBench) that are grounded in safety policies covering ethical categories like hate speech and violence, the primary research objective is the technical analysis of defense mechanisms ('safety shift' and 'harmfulness discrimination') and their impact on the safety-helpfulness trade-off, rather than an evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or frameworks.
